## Description

Constructs Vietoris-Rips complexes from multi-asset correlation point clouds, tracking topological persistence diagrams (Betti numbers) to detect structural market stress prior to crashes.

## Where it may fit

Pre-crash market environments, systemic liquidity crunches, structural correlation breakdowns.

## Vehicles

Tail-risk hedge funds, institutional risk management desks.

## Required data

Rolling correlation matrices across large asset universes, high-frequency return vectors.

## Caveats

Computation of persistence homology diagrams is memory intensive for large asset dimensions.
